//Serilog: Minimum levels only — sinks are configured in code (Logging/SerilogSetup.cs), because ReadFrom.Configuration ADDS sinks rather than replacing them and a WriteTo here would double every line. Serilog replaces the built-in logging providers entirely (§15), which is why there is no longer a `Logging` section: it would be read by nothing.

Jwt.//: Issuer and audience are validated strictly on every token and have no safe default — an unset value fails startup by design (§25).

Lockout.//: Per-account brute-force lockout (§16), approved at 5 failures / 15 minutes. Enabled has no entry here on purpose: it defaults to true in code, and an operator who wants it off has to add the key deliberately rather than flip an existing one.
